options.misconception: selects ‘ba with fatha (بَ)’ whose written shape resembles the target but whose sense differs

selects ‘ba with dagger alif (بٰ)’ whose written shape resembles the target but whose sense differs

questions.explanation: The blank is filled by ‘بّ’, which means ‘ba carrying doubling sign’ and fits the setting. An arch above a doubled consonant on this consonant. The other forms belong to different items; choosing one would make the dialogue coherent in grammar but wrong in meaning.
